properties.name: The Rectory
properties.description: A substantial detached listed family home dating back to the 1800’s, offering superb space, character and plenty of potential all within the heart of St Martin’s village. ‘The Rectory’ is a substantial six bedroom period home, with accommodation arranged over three floors and character throughout. The property offers ample reception and entertaining space, complemented by high ceilings and plenty of light. Externally, the property enjoys a south-west facing garden, together with a useful storage barn, greenhouse and two garages. The roof has recently been renewed and the property now presents an exciting opportunity for a new owner to modernise and renovate subject to necessary permissions.

properties.name: Heavenly
properties.description: This smart semi detached bungalow, built in 1972, is located within a short distance of the amenities of L’Islet Village, bus routes, restaurants and the desirable beaches and coastal paths that the area has to offer. The accommodation comprises two bedrooms served by a family bathroom, lounge/diner with multi fuel stove, kitchen and separate utility room. Externally there is parking for 2-3 vehicles on the front drive and to the rear, and enclosed west facing courtyard garden complete with large shed.

properties.name: Seefeld
properties.description: A charming three-bedroom, two-bathroom period home which offers a blank canvas for those looking to modernise and refurbish to their own personal taste. With two generously sized reception rooms, a kitchen/diner, and a handy utility, all boasting good ceiling height and classic proportions, Seefeld presents an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to create a warm and welcoming family home. Set on a good-sized plot within walking distance of the town centre, the property further benefits from a mature garden, garage, and off-street parking.

properties.name: Goldings
properties.description: Situated close to both the amenities of St Martin’s Village and St Peter Port and just a short walk from the coastal paths and picturesque Fermain Bay, this traditional Guernsey granite home offers a super balance of accommodation spanning three floors. The accommodation comprises five bedrooms, including two en-suite plus family bathroom, alongside a lounge, dining room and spacious newly fitted kitchen. Externally the property benefits from a private west facing garden and double garage together with convenient parking to the front. A super opportunity to acquire a fine Guernsey residence in a convenient setting.

properties.name: Flat 3, Waverley
properties.description: This first floor apartment is conveniently located within a building of four units within walking distance from the main amenities of St Peter Port. Converted in 2002, the accommodation comprises an open plan kitchen living area, bedroom and shower room. Externally, there is use of a communal utility room, a communal low-maintenance courtyard garden, and a one-third share of the parking area. Please note, the property is currently tenanted on a rolling lease.

properties.name: Les Houards de Bas
properties.description: Dating back to the 1700s, this detached traditional farmhouse sits in a peaceful valley at the top of Petit Bot bay. The three-bedroom property offers scope for modernisation, renovation and extension, subject to permissions. Externally, amenities include ample parking, garaging, stabling and further outbuildings. To the rear, an agricultural field of approx. 3.2 acres (7 vergees, 36 perch) plus a further parcel of approx. 0.84 acres (2 vergees, 3 perch). An exciting opportunity to acquire a traditional Guernsey farmhouse with plenty of potential.

Set within mature gardens and with ample parking, viewing is highly recommended by Cooper Brouard.

There is a bright and airy open plan kitchen living room with doors opening out on to the enclosed garden plus two allocated parking spaces.

properties.name: Le Pre
properties.description: This charming traditional country house is nestled in a beautiful south-facing valley in the heart of rural St Peter’s parish. A cherished family home since 1972, it boasts extensive accommodation across three floors, along with large vine house, a fruit house, and a detached two-storey barn. Set within 3 vergee 28 perch (1.5 acres) of mature gardens, the property features fruit and specimen trees, vibrant flower borders, and terraced lawns that gently slope down to a meandering stream. Beyond the gardens lies an additional 5 vergee (2 acres) of agricultural land, offering a rare opportunity to enjoy a truly idyllic country lifestyle.

properties.name: Liberty
properties.description: Liberty is a charming, detached bungalow situated along a peaceful lane on the outskirts of St Peter Port, just a short stroll from the beautiful Fermain Bay. The accommodation comprises a lounge/dining room, kitchen, sun room, shower room, separate WC, and three bedrooms. Externally, the property benefits from a front garden, a south-facing rear garden, and a further agricultural area planted with apple trees, providing excellent outdoor space and potential for those with a keen interest in gardening. There is ample on-street parking available in the immediate vicinity.

properties.name: Holly Lodge
properties.description: This charming semi detached listed home offers well proportioned accommodation over three floors. The ground floor comprises a spacious kitchen/diner, dual-aspect lounge, snug/bedroom 4 and WC. To the first floor are two double bedrooms with a family bathroom and the second floor provides a further bedroom together with dressing room. Externally the property benefits from attractive fore and rear gardens together with parking for 2-3 vehicles accessed via a shared driveway.

properties.name: Flat 1, 27, Paris Street
properties.description: This listed one-bedroom maisonette offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or those seeking a low-maintenance home. The well-presented accommodation features a bright and spacious open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, ideal for modern living and entertaining. In addition to the double bedroom, there is a versatile study/nursery, perfect for home working or additional accommodation. A contemporary shower room completes the interior. Externally, the property benefits from access to a shared garden serving just two properties. Ample on-street parking is available nearby, and with the added benefit of no onward chain.

properties.name: Investment Opportunity – 1, The Palms
properties.description: A superb investment opportunity, built in 2022, conveniently positioned close to the amenities of Admiral Park and Town with two allocated parking spaces. This well proportioned property comprises three bedrooms, main bedroom with en-suite, family bathroom and guest WC. There is a bright and airy open plan kitchen living room with doors opening out on to the enclosed garden. Please note the property is tenanted until end of July 2027 and is suitable for investors only.

properties.name: 32 Norman Terrace
properties.description: This semi detached property is conveniently situated on the outskirts of St Peter Port and is surrounded by on street parking options. Although in need of modernisation, the property offers well proportioned rooms and has previously had plans passed to create a large single story living space to the rear of the property. A delightful rear garden completes the package and viewing is recommended for those who would like to take on a bit of a project.

properties.name: L’Oasis
properties.description: Boasting an elevated position overlooking the historic Castle Cornet, L’Oasis is an exceptional property that blends elegance with contemporary comfort. With sea views and beautifully landscaped gardens, this impressive home presents a truly rare opportunity. Designed to maximise natural light and space, the property offers bright, airy interiors with expansive, open-plan living areas that flow effortlessly to the outdoors. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame spectacular views. A self-contained one-bedroom wing (La Cachette) offers ideal guest accommodation, could be utilised as an independent rental or has the potential to be seamlessly incorporated into the main house. Just a short stroll from the heart of St. Peter Port, L’Oasis offers the perfect combination of coastal serenity and convenient town living. Viewing of this superb home is essential to appreciate all on offer. NB: Permissions have been granted to erect single storey detached outbuilding/garage to west of property.

properties.name: Vue Des Etoiles
properties.description: A modern bungalow in a desirable St Martin’s location. Vue des Etoiles has been beautifully renovated by its current owners over recent years and offers versatile single-level living options. The accommodation comprises of two bedrooms, a study (presently used as a kitchenette), utility, open-plan kitchen/diner, separate lounge and bathroom. The property also benefits from a separate unit in the garden which houses a kitchenette/living/bedroom studio space, a utility/wardrobe area and a shower room to the rear. With ample garden and parking for numerous vehicles, Vue des Etoiles would suit both buyers looking to downsize as well as those looking to move up the property ladder.

properties.name: Laurent Perrier
properties.description: This charming lower ground floor apartment forms part of a traditional listed townhouse, converted in 2007, and has been stylishly presented throughout. The well-proportioned accommodation comprises a welcoming lounge/ diner, a well-equipped kitchen, an upgraded shower room and an elegant bedroom with fitted storage. To the outside, a private courtyard provides a pleasant space for alfresco dining and relaxation, while also benefiting from a useful storage area. The property is offered to the market in move in condition and would be an excellent opportunity for first time buyers or investors alike.

properties.name: Investment Opportunity – Apartment 5, La Salerie Inn
properties.description: A superb investment opportunity, this second floor apartment forms part of a purpose-built seafront development, enjoying stunning sea and offshore island views. Ideally situated within a few minutes’ walk of the town centre. The property has been finished to an extremely high standard with top of the range kitchen and bathroom. There is one allocated parking space for the apartment. Please note that the property is tenanted until 6th July 2027 and is suitable for investors only. It is currently achieving £2,378.20 per month in rental income.

properties.name: Gallifrey
properties.description: Built in 2000 and well presented throughout, ‘Gallifrey’ offers deceptively spacious accommodation and warrants internal viewing to appreciate all that this super family home has to offer. The ground floor accommodation comprises a kitchen/breakfast room, utility/ storage room, lounge/diner, conservatory, shower room and fourth bedroom (currently used as a study). Upstairs offers a main bedroom suite complete with dressing area and en-suite, a family bathroom and two further bedrooms. To the front of the property are three parking spaces; to the rear, an enclosed low maintenance garden laid to astro turf and paving, with access to 1 additional allocated parking space.

properties.name: Figures Barn
properties.description: This charming 2 bed cottage enjoys a highly desirable and convenient location, offering flexible accommodation and plenty of character. With wonderful gardens to the front and rear, it provides a lovely outdoor setting. In need of modernisation throughout, this much-loved, one-owner home presents an exciting opportunity to create something truly special.

properties.name: 4, Inglewood Place
properties.description: This semi-detached property is situated in a convenient location between St Peter Port and The Bridge. Offering well-presented accommodation, the property comprises a lounge, kitchen, two bedrooms, a study which is currently utilised as a bedroom, and a shower room. Externally, the property benefits from parking for two vehicles to the front, with the option to rent a further two spaces across the road. To the rear there is a low-maintenance enclosed courtyard. In addition, there is a useful, detached outbuilding and separate store, providing excellent storage or workshop space.

properties.name: Hillmount
properties.description: Situated in a elevated town position, this four bedroom semi-detached house, although in need of renovation, offers well proportioned accommodation throughout. The property comprises a lounge, dining room, kitchen and four bedrooms with family bathroom and separate WC. Externally the property benefits from an enclosed rear garden which is predominantly laid to lawn with a patio area and raised beds. On street parking is available in the immediate area. A great family home which offers a new owner the opportunity to modernise to personal taste.

properties.name: 7, Les Caches Court
properties.description: This top floor apartment is conveniently situated in St Martins with the village amenities just a short walk away. The property is smartly presented throughout with a newly fitted kitchen/ diner, bright and spacious lounge, two bedrooms and bathroom. There is a floored attic providing excellent storage, communal gardens, parking space and additional visitor parking.

properties.name: Bijou de la Mer
properties.description: Positioned just off the main Cobo coast road, Bijou de la Mer offers an exciting opportunity for a family to acquire a well proportioned traditional cottage. The accommodation comprises four bedrooms in the main house serviced by a shower room and en-suite to bedroom four, kitchen, lounge and further living/dining room. The wing offers an open plan kitchen living space, bedroom and bathroom. There is ample storage space at first floor level, an enclosed rear garden, parking for four vehicles and a garage. With the opportunity to modernise to personal taste throughout, viewing is recommended by Cooper Brouard to appreciate all on offer.

properties.name: Davana Vista
properties.description: Situated in a superb position on a quiet rural lane above Petit Bot, Davana Vista presents a rare and exciting opportunity to create a truly exceptional home in one of the island’s most desirable locations. Occupying a fantastic site with delightful views down towards the valley, the property is in need of renovation but offers enormous potential for enhancement. Alternatively, subject to the relevant planning permissions, the site may lend itself to redevelopment, providing the opportunity to design and build a stunning bespoke home that fully capitalises on its enviable setting, outlook and surroundings. Further benefits include a spacious driveway offering ample parking. A unique project with outstanding potential, Davana Vista is perfect for those seeking to create a remarkable home in a beautiful rural location.

On the first floor, a generous principal bedroom is complemented by a shower room, office and balcony. Ample parking, large south facing garden together with an attached garage complete the offering.

properties.name: Tasha Drive
properties.description: This end of terrace home, built in 1995, forms part of an established and well maintained clos of similar properties in a convenient location just a short drive from the amenities of St Martin’s Village and Town. The accommodation comprises a good size lounge diner, kitchen, conservatory which was added in 2003 and two double bedrooms complete with fitted storage serviced by a contemporary shower room. Externally, there is an allocated parking space alongside ample visitor parking and a private enclosed, low maintenance garden.

properties.name: La Croix
properties.description: A traditional, detached granite house on over half an acre, situated in the desirable parish of Torteval offering great potential to become a super country home. Positioned on a quiet lane and on a large plot, the accommodation offers four bedrooms, a study, bathroom with separate WC, kitchen and four reception rooms. Externally there is ample parking and a large mature garden with mature trees and shrubs with a small greenhouse and allotment area. A great project for those looking to create a fantastic family home.

Ample parking and a well-maintained garden complete the offering of this property.

properties.name: Le Bourg
properties.description: ‘Le Bourg’ offers a rare opportunity in a highly desirable location, offering both immediate income and excellent redevelopment potential. The property currently comprises three commercial units alongside a two bedroom local market apartment. The residential unit and one of the commercial units are tenanted on a rolling lease basis, while the remaining two commercial units are vacant and offer scope for improvement. Planning permission has been granted to redevelop the site to create four contemporary two-bedroom apartments and one one-bedroom unit, presenting a fantastic opportunity to maximise value - alternatively, purchasers may choose to refurbish and modernise the existing accommodation, unlocking its full potential while retaining the current mix of uses and income stream. Le Bourg represents an exceptional opportunity for developers and investors alike.

properties.name: Mount View
properties.description: A charming detached cottage, situated just moments from the West Coast offering flexible living accommodation. Mount View currently comprises three bedrooms served by two bath/ shower rooms, a spacious lounge, dining room, a well appointed main kitchen and a further kitchenette. The former garage has been thoughtfully adapted and is currently utilised as a cosy snug, adding to the property’s flexible layout. Externally, the property benefits from generous parking and an attractive garden.

properties.name: Investment Opportunity – 2, La Maison Rozel
properties.description: This super semi detached home, offered to the market to investors only, offers spacious and bright accommodation throughout and is positioned within close proximity to both the amenities of Admiral Park and Town. The ground floor comprises an en-suite bedroom, utility, WC and open plan kitchen living room which opens out on to the south facing patio and garden. On the first floor, a family bathroom, main bedroom with en-suite and dressing room and further bedroom complete the offering. With tenants in situ until April 2027, this property is a great investment opportunity.

properties.name: Stars Hollow
properties.description: This attractive semi detached home offers spacious and well presented accommodation throughout with two large bedrooms, lounge, dining room, four piece bathroom, conservatory and modern kitchen. The property has been upgraded within the last six years including new electrics, plumbing, kitchen and bathroom together with replastering and redecorating throughout. Externally, Stars Hollow benefits from an enclosed rear garden with sunny aspect. There is on street parking and the option of rented parking available within close proximity.

properties.name: 3, St John’s Terrace
properties.description: This beautifully presented Listed terraced townhouse offers a superb blend of period charm and contemporary style with sea views enjoyed from the upper floors. Arranged over three floors, the accommodation throughout has been tastefully presented. The ground floor features a lounge, dining room and kitchen/ breakfast room which opens out on to the private south-facing walled garden. The first floor comprises two good sized bedrooms serviced by a family shower room and the second floor is dedicated to the main bedroom complete with en-suite bathroom. Close to nearby amenities and surrounded by on street and rented parking options, this property truly warrants internal viewing to appreciate all on offer.

properties.name: CONFIDENTIAL – Investment Property
properties.description: Available to investors only, this two bedroom apartment is convenient situated on the outskirts of Town and further boasts two allocated parking spaces. Please contact the Local Market Sales team on 01481 236039 for further information.

properties.name: 2 Kinross Cottages
properties.description: A charming two bedroomed semi-detached cottage situated inland from Grandes Rocques and Cobo bays. The bedrooms are located on the first floor with sitting room, dining room, kitchen and bathroom located on the ground floor. Large rear garden and patio areas together with parking for several cars.

properties.name: Les Loumaies
properties.description: This attractive two-bedroom bungalow, “Les Loumaies”, has been extensively renovated in recent years, having been almost entirely rebuilt. The works have incorporated eco floors, warm roof construction, underfloor heating, an all-electric system and a 90mm wrap to the original three walls. The new-build elements are also constructed on engineered piling, with approximately 75% of the foundations being new. The property enjoys far-reaching sea views towards the Hanois lighthouse and features an impressive open-plan kitchen, living and dining space, providing a wonderful hub to the home and making the most of its coastal aspect. Two generous bedrooms, both benefiting from en-suite facilities, together with a guest WC and utility room, complete the accommodation. Outside, there is ample parking and a delightful rear garden, currently featuring a predominantly paved layout designed with outdoor entertaining in mind. The garden includes an attractive koi pond, greenhouse and pétanque area. The garden offers considerable scope to be easily reconfigured and simplified, should the new owners wish to create a lower-maintenance outdoor space. A further notable feature is the detached chalet, complete with a bar and log burner, providing an excellent additional space for entertaining, relaxing or pursuing hobbies.

properties.name: La Soufleuresse
properties.description: This distinctive family home is positioned on an elevated site above Richmond Bay with panoramic views across the west coast. Thoughtfully designed throughout, the flexible accommodation currently comprises a three bedroom main house together with a self-contained two bedroom wing – ideal for dependant relatives. The main house boasts an abundance of living space with conservatory, separate sitting room and open plan kitchen/lounge/diner. Established gardens surround the property, with a sun terrace and deck positioned to enjoy the views, while ample parking and excellent storage complete the offering. With no onward chain, viewing is recommended to appreciate all on offer

properties.name: Happy Days
properties.description: A two-bedroom terraced home offered with no onward chain, ideally situated in a convenient location on The Bridge. The property comprises a lounge, kitchen and utility area on the ground floor, with two double bedrooms and a family bathroom on the first floor. Externally, there is an enclosed courtyard garden with the added benefit of a workshop and outside WC. On-street parking is available in the immediate area. Requiring some modernisation, this property offers a great opportunity for buyers to update and make it their own. The fully boarded loft provides excellent storage space and, subject to the necessary planning permission and building regulations approval, has the potential to be converted into an additional bedroom.

properties.name: Flat 3, Maitland
properties.description: This first floor apartment forms part of a converted building (completed in 2000) and is positioned in a convenient location nearby to the amenities of The Bridge, Admiral Park and Town. The accommodation comprises the main bedroom with fitted storage and a child’s bedroom/study, bathroom, lounge and kitchen/breakfast room. Flat 3 further boasts an enclosed garden area which is for the sole use of this flat and there is also the added benefit of rented parking available by separate negotiation on site. A great starter home or investment opportunity.

properties.name: La Croix D’Argent
properties.description: A well-presented semi-detached property which has been renovated throughout during the current ownership and boasts stables and a field to the rear. La Croix D’Argent blends good reception space alongside two bedrooms and versatile study/nursery serviced by an en-suite to the main bedroom and a family bathroom. The front of the property offers parking for up to four vehicles and to the rear, two stables and a store with an agricultural field to the rear measuring 3 vergees and 30.98 perch (approx. 1 and a half acres) making this an ideal property for those with an equestrian lifestyle or anyone looking for space to rear animals and grow produce.

properties.description: This deceptively spacious semi-detached property sits in an elevated position close to the amenities of Admiral Park and the Bridge. Externally there is a low maintenance enclosed courtyard garden and on street parking in the immediate area plus the opportunity to take over a transferable rented parking space.

properties.name: Apartment 13, Ebenezer Church
properties.description: Seamlessly blending historic architecture with modern comforts, this second floor apartment features a spacious kitchen living area, bedroom and bathroom. With on street parking in the immediate area and within close proximity to Town, this apartment would suit a host of purchasers.

properties.name: Apartment 4, Ebenezer Church
properties.description: Seamlessly blending historic architecture with modern comforts, this ground floor apartment features a spacious kitchen living area, bedroom plus study and bathroom. Within close proximity to Town and complete with allocated parking space, this apartment would suit a host of purchasers.

properties.name: Petite Fleur
properties.description: Located in a convenient and central position, ‘Petite Fleur’ offers great potential for those looking to place their own stamp on a property by ways of modernisation and upgrading. The current accommodation comprises three bedrooms, bathroom, separate WC, utility, an open plan kitchen/dining space plus separate lounge and conservatory. There is ample parking at the front of the property and to the rear, an enclosed southwest facing lawned garden complete with a stable and tack room.

properties.name: Le Desert
properties.description: Nestled along a peaceful country lane in the heart of St Saviour’s, this charming granite farmhouse presents a rare and exciting opportunity to create a truly exceptional home. Surrounded by open agricultural fields and unspoilt countryside, the property enjoys a tranquil setting that offers both privacy and picturesque views yet remains within easy reach of local amenities. Set in approximately 6 acres (15 Vergees & 5.65 Perches) of agricultural land, this substantial property boasts an abundance of potential. The traditional stone-built residence, steeped in character, exudes timeless appeal with its symmetrical façade and slate roof. Inside, the accommodation is generously proportioned, offering an ideal canvas for modernisation and reconfiguration to suit contemporary living. With scope to extend (subject to planning), the possibilities for enhancement are as broad as your imagination. The exterior of the property is equally compelling, with a diverse range of outbuildings including attractive stone barns, six loose boxes, a timber store, and a feed store, all providing versatile space for equestrian use, hobby farming, or potential ancillary accommodation (subject to necessary permissions). Whether you are seeking a peaceful family retreat, a working smallholding, or a redevelopment opportunity, this property is brimming with potential. With its idyllic rural location, traditional features, and extensive grounds, it offers a rare lifestyle opportunity in one of Guernsey’s most sought-after parishes.

properties.description: This attractive Victorian semi‑detached home enjoys a highly convenient location close to Town and The Bridge, with Delancey Park, local shops and beaches all within easy walking distance. A superb home offering generous living space for a family, sharers, or anyone seeking a substantial property — it truly needs to be viewed to be fully appreciated.

properties.description: This traditional semi-detached granite cottage offers pleasant rural views and an opportunity to create a charming family home. properties.description: Rock View is a deceptively spacious detached home perfectly positioned for the beautiful ever changing views that L’Eree Bay has to offer. properties.name: Murnau
properties.description: The four bedroom detached home offers spacious accommodation throughout and presents an excellent opportunity for a new owner to create a super family home. The ground floor comprises a generous lounge and kitchen diner. Upstairs, the property benefits from four bedrooms – main bedroom en-suite, together with a family bathroom. Externally, Murnau enjoys a fore garden with driveway parking, a car port and a further garage. To the rear is an established south facing garden. Although requiring modernisation, the property provides an exciting opportunity and viewing is recommended to appreciate all on offer.

properties.name: Maya
properties.description: A detached bungalow set in an elevated position within the tranquil surroundings of St Peter’s Valley, offering a peaceful and private setting. The accommodation comprises a lounge, kitchen/dining room, and two bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with ensuite shower room. A separate study provides flexibility for home working or additional use, complemented by a family bathroom. Externally, the property benefits from gravelled parking to the rear for two vehicles, along with a large garage capable of accommodating two cars in tandem. The garden is partly laid to lawn with an additional gravelled area, offering a manageable outdoor space within this picturesque valley location.

properties.name: La Moye Farm
properties.description: A charming detached listed farmhouse situated in the peaceful lanes between L’Ancresse Common and Beaucette Marina with plans approved. The main house itself comprises a kitchen, dining room, sitting room and two bedrooms plus a study serviced by a family bathroom. Sympathetically renovated by a highly regarded local developer, the scheme successfully blends the character of the original building with contemporary design and modern living. Apartment 9 is a two-bedroom apartment, finished to an excellent specification throughout. The apartment benefits from secure underground parking for one vehicle, together with a private gated storage unit, providing both convenience and practicality. Ideally positioned within easy reach of the amenities, shops and restaurants of St Peter Port, these apartments present an outstanding opportunity for first-time buyers, professionals and investors alike.

properties.name: Apartment 6 Valnord Apartments
properties.description: This superb new development has transformed an attractive granite warehouse into an exclusive collection of ten beautifully appointed apartments on the outskirts of St Peter Port. properties.name: Le Picquet
properties.description: 'Le Picquet' is a stylish and low-maintenance maisonette, arranged over three floors within a highly regarded, exclusive development. Benefitting from its own private entrance. the property offers well-proportioned accommodation, including two double bedrooms, two bath/shower rooms, and a separate WC. At its heart lies a well-equipped kitchen and an open-plan living space, thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertaining. Two sets of double doors open directly onto a private decked terrace, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Further enhancing the appeal, the property includes an allocated secure parking space, additional visitor parking, generous loft storage, and a secure basement storage unit, completing this superb and convenient home.

properties.name: Top Floor Apartment Bevlyn
properties.description: Situated in a peaceful rural location in the north of the island, Top Floor Flat, "Bevlyn" is a spacious and recently renovated apartment offering bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout. At the heart of the home is a generous lounge/dining room, providing an inviting space for both relaxation and entertaining, complemented by a fitted kitchen and modern three-piece bathroom. The property features two bedrooms, including an impressive principal bedroom with a large dressing room and direct access to its own private terrace, creating a wonderful retreat to enjoy the surrounding tranquillity. Presenting an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or those seeking a low-maintenance home, this attractive apartment is sure to appeal and early viewing is highly recommended.

properties.name: Belle Haven
properties.description: Belle Haven is a charming two-bedroom cottage tucked away down a private track on the outskirts of St Peter Port, offering a wonderful combination of privacy, character and convenience. The accommodation comprises a spacious lounge, kitchen and bathroom on the ground floor. Upstairs are two well-proportioned bedrooms, along with a useful loft space providing additional storage. The property also benefits from planning permission to extend to the side. Outside, the sizeable garden has been beautifully landscaped with a patio, lawn and mature shrubs, creating an ideal space for relaxing or entertaining. Occupying a stunning elevated position, the property enjoys delightful sea views across Guernsey's east coast. To the front there is tandem parking for two vehicles and additional visitor parking. The property is offered to the market with no onward chain, making it an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers or those seeking a peaceful home within easy reach of town.

properties.name: Folie Maison
properties.description: 'Folie Maison' is a charming mid-terrace family home arranged over three floors, offering spacious and versatile accommodation throughout. The ground floor features a generous lounge/dining room, a well-appointed kitchen, and a convenient cloakroom/WC. On the first floor are two double bedrooms and a family bathroom, while the second floor provides a useful attic room, currently utilised as a bedroom. Externally, the property benefits from an enclosed garden, ideal for outdoor enjoyment, together with on-street parking nearby.

properties.name: 9 Meadow Grove
properties.description: 9 Meadow Grove is a well presented first floor maisonette, arranged over the top two floors of this well-regarded development on the St Peter Port / St Andrew’s border. This notably bright and spacious home offers two generously proportioned double bedrooms, including a main suite with en-suite shower room. In addition, there is a large family bathroom, a well-appointed kitchen, and an inviting sitting room which is complemented by a mezzanine level gallery—ideal as a study or home office space. The development itself is set within extensive, well-maintained communal gardens. Number 9 also benefits from allocated parking for one vehicle, along with ample visitors’ parking. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the scale, layout and quality of accommodation on offer.

properties.name: Pride Rock
properties.description: 'Pride Rock' is a stunning mid-terrace cottage located just a short walk from local amenities. The property has been thoughtfully and stylishly redecorated by its current owners, resulting in a property that is in truly 'turn-key' condition. The accomodation comprises of a smart living room, a well-equipped kitchen which overlooks a low maintenance sunny rear garden. On the first floor, there is a double bedroom with ample built-in storage and a well-appointed family bathroom. The top floor consists of a second bedroom with views over the garden and thoughtful storage. Early viewing of this special home is highly recommended.

properties.name: La Croisie
properties.description: ‘La Croisie’ is a beautiful, traditional Guernsey cottage set in a tranquil location within walking distance to Petit Bot Bay. Presenting an exciting opportunity for a renovation project this charming home is ready to be lovingly restored by its new owner and made into a wonderful family home. The accommodation comprises a kitchen, living room, bathroom and two bedrooms downstairs as well as two further bedrooms upstairs and a useful loft space. Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the potential that this detached property has to offer.

properties.name: Mirabelle
properties.description: A super three bedroom property in a quiet and convenient location just a few minutes from drive Town. 'Mirabelle' features three double bedrooms, lounge/dining room and smart fitted kitchen. Outside is a low maintenance and sunny courtyard, single garage and parking.

properties.name: Ard Na Mara
properties.description: ‘Ard Na Mara’ is a well-presented, recently renovated two-bedroom semi-detached home, situated in a convenient central location on the outskirts of St Peter Port. The property offers well-proportioned accommodation throughout. The ground floor comprises a bright and inviting lounge, a separate dining room, a galley-style kitchen, and a bathroom, providing a practical and comfortable layout for modern living. Upstairs, there are two generous double bedrooms, with the main bedroom benefitting from an ensuite shower room. Externally, the property enjoys excellent parking provisions, with space for two cars at the front and additional parking for several vehicles to the rear. The rear garden is laid to lawn, creating a pleasant outdoor space, and is complemented by a good-sized storeroom offering valuable additional storage.

properties.name: No 3 Le Chateaux De La Montagne
properties.description: This spacious and newly built two-bedroom end-of-terrace townhouse is ideally situated in the heart of St Peter Port, forming part of a small and recently completed development. Arranged over three floors, the accommodation comprises a contemporary kitchen that opens onto a private patio, creating an excellent space for both everyday living and entertaining. There is also a separate lounge, offering a comfortable and well-proportioned reception area. Upstairs, the property provides two well-sized bedrooms, complemented by a modern shower room and a dedicated utility area. Externally, to the rear, there is a fully enclosed paved patio providing a low-maintenance outdoor space. The property also benefits from one allocated parking space. Conveniently positioned, the townhouse is within easy walking distance of St Peter Port’s shops, restaurants, and amenities.

properties.name: Saresqueta
properties.description: Saresqueta is a charming two-bedroom bungalow, ideally situated close to the West Coast's beautiful sandy beaches. The accommodation comprises a spacious living room, kitchen, bathroom with a separate W.C., two double bedrooms, and a generous conservatory. Externally, the property benefits from a low-maintenance gardens and a single garage. While some modernisation would enhance the property throughout, it offers an excellent opportunity to acquire a bungalow in a highly desirable location.

properties.name: Heavenly
properties.description: Situated in a quiet lane and just a short stroll from Le Grand Havre beach, this well-presented semi-detached bungalow offers comfortable, low-maintenance living in a convenient location. Featuring fully enclosed rear garden, parking for two to three cars, and local amenities close by, the property is ideally suited to those seeking a relaxed coastal lifestyle.

properties.name: Development Opportunity
properties.description: Offered to the market with full planning permision; a unique opportunity to develop a commercial building in Les Amballes, St Peter Port. The current plans have been drawn with the option to build two semi detached units and a separate detached dwelling, each with allocated parking. The detached unit consist of an open plan living space, two bedrooms, shower room and mezzanine level. The two semi detached houses have differing layouts, consisting of kitchen/ diner/ separate lounge, two bedrooms and shower room. Situated on the edge of St Peter Port the properties are conveniently located only a short walk from town and Admiral Park.

properties.name: Apartment 1, Clifton Heights
properties.description: Built in 2013 Apartment 1 Clifton Heights is a stunning two bedroom apartment situated on the lower level that looks out onto a spacious communal terrace. The property consists of a high spec open plan living space, comprising a lounge, kitchen with island/ breakfast bar and dining area. There are two good sized bedrooms. The main bedroom has an en suite and plenty of wardrobe space. The second bedroom opens up to a jack and jill shower room. The apartment benefits from secure parking for one car and can be accessed direct from the communal lift. Situated only a short walk from the heart of St Peter Port the property is perfectly positioned for the local amenities and restaurants.

properties.name: Glendale
properties.description: Glendale is an immaculately presented end of terrace home that has been carefully renovated and maintained by the current owners. The accommodation comprises of a downstairs bedroom, cloakroom and a modern kitchen leading onto a dining/living room that is flooded with light and offers direct access to the garden. Upstairs there are two further double bedrooms and the family shower room. Outside the garden is fully enclosed and has a sunny patio and an area of astro-turf for ease of maintenance as well as a timber gate providing access to the single garage. This lovely home would suit a multitude of buyers so internal viewing is highly recommended.

properties.name: Kirkby
properties.description: Kirkby is a superb mid-terrace property that has been extensively renovated and redecorated throughout. The property features a brand-new kitchen, bathroom, and utility room, along with a bright living room. A versatile ground-floor room can be used as a third bedroom or separate dining room. Upstairs are two good-sized bedrooms. To the rear is a generous lawned garden and off-road parking for up to four vehicles. This property is offered to the market with no forward chain.

properties.name: Shamrock Cottage
properties.description: Shamrock Cottage is a charming detached bungalow located in St Peter Port, presented to market with no onward chain. This delightful home offers three spacious double bedrooms and a welcoming living room featuring a working fireplace. The property benefits from a well-equipped kitchen, a family bathroom, and a bright sunroom overlooking the garden. An additional utility room provides extra convenience and storage space. Outside, the garden is partly laid to patio and partly to lawn, creating an ideal space for both relaxing and entertaining. To the front of the property, there is parking for up to three vehicles.

properties.name: 2 Hazeldene
properties.description: 2 Hazeldene is a semi-detached family home offering well proportioned accommodation with generous living space, presenting an excellent opportunity for purchasers seeking a property with scope to modernise and add value. The accommodation comprises three bedrooms together with flexible living areas, complemented by a small basement providing useful storage. Externally, the property enjoys an enclosed garden, which incorporates a block built outbuilding offering further storage or potential for ancillary use, subject to requirements. There is also parking available for up to three vehicles.

properties.name: Claremont
properties.address: La Colline Des Bas Courtils, St Saviour's
properties.description: Situated within a quiet clos in the sought-after parish of St Saviour, 'Claremont' is a well-presented family home offers spacious accommodation arranged over three floors. The property features three bedrooms, including a main bedroom with en-suite shower room, providing comfortable and versatile living for modern family life. Conveniently located close to local amenities, the home also benefits from parking for two vehicles and a low-maintenance garden, perfect for those seeking easy outdoor enjoyment.

properties.name: Ground Floor Apartment Bevlyn
properties.description: Recently renovated throughout, this spacious ground-floor apartment enjoys a wonderfully peaceful setting in the rural north of the island. Offering over 2,000 sq. ft. of light-filled accommodation, Ground Floor Apartment, "Bevlyn" combines generous living space with low-maintenance convenience. The impressive reception areas are a particular feature of the home, comprising a comfortable sitting room, a well-appointed kitchen/breakfast room, a dining room, and a large lounge, complemented by a dedicated office and a practical utility room. The property offers three bedrooms. Two are served by a stylish three-piece family bathroom, while the principal bedroom benefits from extensive fitted storage, a versatile dressing room/home office, and an en-suite shower room. Externally, the property provides ample parking and an enclosed, easy-to-maintain garden, ideal for enjoying outdoor space with minimal upkeep. Whether as a superb downsizing opportunity or a spacious family home, this exceptional apartment offers flexible accommodation in a lovely location.

properties.name: Petit Havre
properties.description: Petit Havre is a charming Edwardian townhouse ideally positioned on the edge of St Peter Port. This well-presented home offers two spacious bedrooms, a separate study, and a flexible living layout. The ground floor features a bright lounge with an attractive bay window overlooking the front of the property. There is a large opening into a dining room creating an open-plan living and entertaining space. To the rear, there is a fitted kitchen and a useful utility / sun room. Upstairs are two generous double bedrooms with built-in wardrobes, a separate study, a family bathroom and a separate WC. Outside, the property benefits from a south facing low-maintenance garden with two storage sheds and convenient rear access.

properties.name: Apartment 17, Vue Du Godfrey
properties.address: Rue De Vega, St Peter Port
properties.description: Apartment 17, Vue Du Godfrey is a stylish, modern apartment located in the prestigious Vega Apartment complex. With views over the East Coast and neighbouring islands, this apartment is a fantastic investment opportunity or low maintenance home. The apartment has two well-proportioned bedrooms, one featuring an en-suite shower room, a further family bathroom and convenient utility room. At the heart of the property is a spacious kitchen, living room and dining room which opens up onto a fantastic balcony with sea views. Internal viewing is highly recommended.

properties.name: Les Potiers
properties.description: Les Potiers is a charming and characterful six-bedroom, six-bathroom home located on Grandes Maisons Road in St Sampson. Set across three spacious levels, the property offers generous living accommodation throughout, including a separate lounge and kitchen. While the house would benefit from some cosmetic updating, it presents an excellent opportunity to create a truly impressive investment/ home. To the rear, there is a well-proportioned garden, ideal for outdoor enjoyment, and to the front, parking is available for two vehicles. Offered to the market with no forward chain, Les Potiers combines space, character, and potential in a good St Sampson's location.

properties.name: Meribel
properties.description: Meribel is a well-presented two-bedroom family home situated in a convenient location in Castel. The property features a bright and homely living room with feature fireplace, a well-appointed utility room and downstairs shower room and a stylish kitchen with double doors that open out onto the garden. Upstairs, the primary bedroom is a generous size with views over the garden and nearby fields, there is a well-appointed family bathroom and good sized second bedroom. Externally, the property benefits from a large, sunny, low-maintenance garden and parking for two vehicles at the front of the property. Internal viewing is highly recommended.

properties.name: Locarno
properties.description: Locarno is a substantial, semi-detached property in an enviable George Road location directly opposite the Val des Terres Common. The accommodation currently comprises a large, open-plan lounge/ diner with separate kitchen and utility room, with Bedroom 5 with shower room ensuite/ snug completing the ground floor offering. On the first floor are three double bedrooms with two ensuite bathrooms/shower rooms, whilst the second floor is home to the fourth bedroom with ensuite bathroom and substantial, easily-accessible loft space. The front of the property is laid to lawn with Tarmac parking for four cars in tandem, whilst to the rear is an enclosed courtyard. Locarno would benefit from cosmetic upgrading and is available immediately with no onward chain.

properties.name: Le Petit Creux
properties.address: La Route Des Coutures, St Martin's
properties.description: Le Petit Creux is a beautifully presented two-bedroom end-of-terrace home, tucked away in the charming and idyllic lanes of St Martin’s. The ground floor offers spacious and well-appointed accommodation, including a bright sitting room, a contemporary bathroom, a convenient utility room, a large, modern kitchen, and a light-filled conservatory perfect for dining or relaxing. Upstairs, the first floor comprises two generous double bedrooms, both offering comfortable and inviting living spaces. Externally, the property benefits from a substantial rear garden that wraps around to the side, providing ample outdoor space for entertaining or enjoying the tranquil surroundings. Beyond the garden, there is off-road parking for 3–4 vehicles. The property is presented with no onward chain.

properties.name: 2 Sausmarez Street
properties.description: 2 Sausmarez Street is a well presented and substantial townhouse, ideally located in the heart of St Peter Port. Arranged over four floors, the property offers an excellent balance of spacious and versatile accommodation. The ground floor features a generous open-plan lounge, dining area and kitchen, creating a bright and sociable living space ideal for modern family life. The upper floors comprise four double bedrooms, with the top floor enjoying stunning views across the East Coast. The first floor also boasts an impressive 5 piece bathroom suite. To the rear, there is a small, enclosed courtyard. There are excellent on street parking options available with Odean car park a short walk away. This attractive townhouse combines character, space and a highly convenient location, making it an ideal home for families and professionals alike.

properties.name: Apartment 14, Hanois
properties.description: Hanois 14 is an incredibly well-appointed second floor apartment situated within the luxurious Royal Terrace development. It possesses a large open plan living area consisting of a designer oak kitchen, and a spacious lounge / dining area which opens out onto a large balcony with great seafront views and roof garden. Hanois 14 has two double bedrooms, both adjoining to a further balcony overlooking the plaza. The master bedroom is fitted with designer furniture and an en-suite shower room. In addition there is a smart family bathroom fully tiled with travertine marble. There is plenty of storage space in the form of a separate utility room and separate cupboards. This apartment also benefits from high speed fibre broadband. Light and spacious throughout, this fantastic low-maintenance home is suited for both professionals and down-sizers alike.

properties.name: West Lynne
properties.description: West Lynne is a detached family home, located on a quiet lane opposite L'Eree bay. The ground floor accomodation comprises kitchen, living/dining room, shower room and two bedrooms. Upstairs, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms. Although requiring modernization throughout, this property presents an exciting opportunity in a fanstastic location. Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the potential that this detached property has to offer.

properties.name: 2 Courtil Fougere
properties.description: A beautifully presented three-bedroom family home, ideally situated in the north of the island close to local shops and amenities. '2 Courtil Fougere' was built in 2016 and offers stylish, low-maintenance living. At the heart of the home is an impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and living space, creating a bright and sociable environment with direct access onto the patio and generously sized enclosed garden. Completing the ground floor is a double bedroom and well appointed shower room. The first floor comprises a bathroom, two bedrooms - one being a spacious principal bedroom with en-suite shower room. Externally, the property benefits from a beautifully proportioned garden, ideal for both entertaining and family use, along with parking for two at the rear and visitor parking.

properties.name: Brymar
properties.description: A charming Guernsey cottage in an idyllic setting in the Vale, 'Brymar' offers up to four bedrooms, characterful reception rooms including a cosy lounge with a working fireplace, and a spacious kitchen/breakfast room. Two of the first-floor bedrooms enjoy lovely views over the Vale Mill and across the north of the island. Outside, the property benefits from parking, a garage, and an attractive enclosed garden. While it would benefit from modernisation, 'Brymar' is fully habitable and presents a fantastic opportunity to create a wonderful home in this highly sought-after location.

properties.name: Woody Haze
properties.description: Woody Haze is a beautifully presented detached bungalow, tucked away at the end of a quiet lane in St Sampson's. At the heart of the home is a stunning open plan kitchen, dining and living area, creating a stylish and sociable space that is perfect for modern family living and entertaining. The accommodation is completed by two well proportioned bedrooms, a well appointed family bathroom, a study, and a rear porch/utility room. Whilst the majority of the property has been extensively renovated and upgraded within the last five years, a degree of finishing is still required in the hallway and rear porch, offering purchasers the opportunity to add their own finishing touches. Externally, the property benefits from an impressive garden enjoying attractive field views to the side, providing a wonderful sense of space and privacy. There are also two large storage sheds and ample parking to the front and side of the property. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this charming home has to offer.

properties.name: Lauder House
properties.description: Situated in a highly convenient St Peter Port location, Lauder House is a spacious and characterful home arranged over four floors, offering flexible accommodation ideal for modern family living. The main house comprises a bright and welcoming kitchen/diner, a comfortable lounge, three well-proportioned bedrooms, a family bathroom, and a separate shower room. At basement level, the property benefits from a newly renovated, self-contained one-bedroom flat. Complete with its own kitchen, lounge/diner, and shower room, this space can be accessed via a private entrance or through the main house, making it ideal for dependent relatives, guests, or as a potential rental opportunity. Externally, the property enjoys a charming, walled garden with a patio area—perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional benefits include on-street parking and the option to rent a nearby parking space for approximately £175 per month.

properties.name: 15, Infinity Lofts
properties.description: Built in 2020, '15 Infinity Lofts' is a stylish three bedroom home ideally located in the heart of St Peter Port, offering modern living with convenience and comfort. The property features a stunning open-plan living area on the ground floor, combining a sleek contemporary kitchen with a spacious lounge—perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. A separate cloakroom completes this level. Across the first and second floors are three well-proportioned bedrooms. The principal bedroom benefits from its own en-suite shower room, while a modern family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms. To the front of the property is a fully enclosed, low-maintenance garden, currently laid with artificial lawn. Further benefits include two allocated parking spaces located within a secure underground car park. This attractive home offers modern, low-maintenance living in a highly desirable town location.

properties.name: 2, La Rochelle Villa
properties.description: A brand new build, located equidistant between the Bridge and Town shopping centres. Offers three bedrooms serviced by two bathrooms on the upper two floors and an open plan kitchen / living area on the ground floor. Externally there is parking for two cars and an enclosed garden to rear.

properties.name: Symphony House
properties.description: ‘Symphony House’ is an immaculately presented period property on the outskirts of St Peter Port. Fully renovated by the current owner the accommodation comprises a characterful sitting room and dining room a contemporary kitchen come dayroom with the possibility of an additional W.C on the ground floor whilst the first floor comprises three bedrooms and family bathroom. To the rear there is a delightful south facing rear garden laid to patio and lawn all bounded by garden wall. To the front there is a garage with one parking space in front.

properties.name: No 2, The Palms
properties.description: No.2 The Palms is a well-presented family home in a convenient location. The property was built less than five years ago and offers an open plan kitchen/diner, downstairs bedroom and separate WC. Upstairs, the accomodation comprieses two bedrooms and two bathrooms, one of which is en-suite. Externally, the property benefits from an enclosed garden which is laid mostly to lawn. No. 2 The Palms is presented to the market chain-free.

properties.name: No.1, The Palms
properties.description: No. 1 The Palms presents a perfect, low maintenance and easy investment opportunity. Currently tenanted and managed until July 2027 this new home was built less than five years ago and offers a popular town location with the bonus of off street parking for two cars. The accommodation compromises of an open plan kitchen/diner, downstairs bedroom and WC. Upstairs there are two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Outside there is an enclosed rear garden that is part patio and part laid to lawn for ease of maintenance.

properties.name: No 3 The Palms
properties.description: A low maintenance, modern home or investment property, located on the outskirts of St Peter Port. Well presented throughout, the property offers three bedrooms served by two bath / shower rooms and a stylish lounge / kitchen enjoying an aspect over the lawned rear garden. Parking for two cars to the front.

properties.name: Moondance
properties.description: ‘Moondance’ is an immaculate home situated within walking distance of Perelle bay on the West Coast. The house offers excellent accommodation including a fully fitted kitchen/diner with bi-folding doors out onto the south facing garden. In addition, there is a separate lounge, utility room and WC on the ground floor while upstairs are three bedrooms, including a master with en-suite shower room and separate family bathroom. Outside, there is a garden laid to patio and artificial lawn, along with parking for two cars. Ensuring the property is as efficient as possible, there are solar panels on the roof to contribute towards the electric heating. Viewing is highly recommended.

properties.name: Bahay Kubo
properties.description: Bahay Kubo is a beautifully presented four-bedroom family home, situated in a peaceful clos within walking distance of Sausmarez Park. Internally, the property benefits from a spacious lounge/dining room, a modern kitchen, and a generous conservatory. The accommodation further comprises four large double bedrooms and two bathrooms. Externally, the property offers an enclosed garden and parking for two vehicles. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality and scope of this home.

properties.name: Ambiance D'eki
properties.description: Ambiance D’eki is a beautifully presented granite barn offering character, charm, and low maintenance living throughout. The first floor comprises three well proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom, while the ground floor features a spacious lounge that flows into a well appointed kitchen, complemented by a separate utility room and WC. The garden provides a wonderfully versatile outdoor space, featuring a patio, lawned area, and an impressive summerhouse—ideal for entertaining or relaxation. To the front of the property, ample parking is available. Further enhancing its appeal, the property benefits from previously approved (now lapsed) planning permission for a two storey side extension. A fantastic family home in a convenient location, early viewing is highly recommended.

properties.name: Rouge Bois
properties.description: This smart detached home was built just seven years ago and is truly tucked away, yet located in the heart of the Bridge shopping centre. Larger than you might expect, the property provides three bedrooms served by two shower rooms, whilst the reception areas include a spacious lounge and equally generous kitchen / breakfast room, along with a separate dining room. Externally there is parking for two cars and a small paved garden to one side of the house. An excellent low maintenance home in a very convenient location.

properties.name: Skyfall
properties.description: Skyfall is a well-presented semi-detached house located on a quiet clos in Castel, close to local amenities. Extended and upgraded by its current owners, this accommodation offers a spacious living room, separate dining room (or fourth bedroom), separate kitchen and downstairs W/C. Upstairs are three well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom. The primary bedroom benefits from vaulted ceilings and the opportunity to put your own stamp on the en-suite bathroom that has plumbing in place already. To the front, there is parking for four vehicles. To the rear, there is a south facing patio and enclosed garden. The property backs onto rural fields, providing a pleasant green outlook. Skyfall is a fantastic, low maintenance family home offering space and convenience alike.

properties.name: Les Rosiers, 5 Courtil Des Charmes.
properties.description: Situated on a well-regarded clos in the Vale, Les Rosiers is a well-presented four-bedroom family home, offering spacious and versatile accommodation throughout. The ground floor comprises a generous double bedroom, cloakroom and an impressive open-plan kitchen/living space. This excellent room provides a wonderful hub to the home, with bi-fold doors opening directly onto the rear garden and creating a seamless connection between the indoor and outdoor spaces. The garage has been thoughtfully divided with a stud wall to provide a useful utility area and additional storage space, whilst still retaining valuable garage accommodation. Upstairs are three further bedrooms and a family bathroom, providing excellent accommodation for families or those requiring additional space. Externally, the property benefits from a beautifully landscaped rear garden, featuring a patio area with steps leading up to an artificial lawn, creating an attractive and low-maintenance outdoor space. To the side, there is parking for two (potentially three for smaller) vehicles. Ideally positioned for access to the northern beaches and the surrounding network of picturesque lane walks, Les Rosiers is an appealing home in a sought-after Vale location.

properties.name: Heathridge
properties.description: Heathridge is a well-proportioned three-bedroom modern built cottage situated in a convenient St Sampson’s location. The ground floor comprises a good-sized lounge, spacious contemporary kitchen and a useful shower room. Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms together with the family bathroom. Externally, the property benefits from a low-maintenance garden, laid predominantly to patio and artificial lawn, providing an easy-to-maintain outdoor space. To the front, there is parking for two vehicles, with the potential to create additional parking (subject to the necessary planning permissions). Ideally positioned for local amenities and within a short distance of Haute Capelles Primary School, Heathridge offers well-balanced accommodation in a convenient location.

properties.name: Pres De L'Eglise
properties.description: Pres De L'eglise is a well presented, semi detached family home situated in a beautiful, quiet location in the lanes of Forest, close to the south coast cliffs. The property offers one double bedroom at ground floor level, serviced by a shower room and a further two double bedrooms on the first floor. The reception space comprises of a lovely cosy lounge complete with fireplace, sun room, and a large kitchen/dining room which backs onto a utility room and WC. Externally there is a beautifully landscaped garden to the rear. At the front, there is parking for 1-2 vehicles.

properties.name: Whispering Sands
properties.description: This detached house is located at Cobo, within an easy walk of the popular beaches and Village. Previously used to provide staff accommodation, it currently offers up to six bedrooms, all ensuite, and has plans approved for a further two storey extension to the rear. Externally, there is parking for 3-4 cars to the front and an enclosed garden to the rear. Some upgrading is required but this is a sizeable property in a highly desirable location.

properties.name: Luminese
properties.description: Situated in a desirable spot only a step away from Saumarez Park, this three to four bedroom semi-detached house is fantastically presented throughout. The living area has recently been opened up to provide a contemporary, generous sized kitchen / dining area with bifold doors leading to a conservatory and snug lounge/bedroom. Completing the ground floor is an integral garage and shower room. On the first floor are two double rooms and a single room along with a family shower room. There is plenty of parking to the front and the back garden has been beautifully landscaped with lawn, mature shrubs and a new patio area.

properties.name: Whincroft Cottage
properties.description: Whincroft Cottage is a stunning development opportunity in the heart of the Island, enjoying superb south facing views across Talbot Valley. The site had outline planning approval (recently lapsed but a fresh application being made) for the existing dwelling to be demolished and a new home to be built on a different, more elevated area within the site. The result would be a family home enjoying superb privacy and stunning rural view, across a total site of approx 1 acre.
